onboarding.note: First parking after a registration indexed in this seven-day window; wallet sign-in time is not recorded.

parking.note: Current and time-weighted occupancy use indexed park, settlement and expiry times. The version-2 capacity switch uses the operator release cutover time because migration emitted no plot-seed events. Time-weighted figures require every launch-city seed event and end at the last indexed block; stale or incomplete indexing limits the measurement.

coinPacing.note: Coin totals cover indexed events only; unpriced historical purchases and starter grants are excluded from their respective totals.

generation.note: A paid candidate review rate requires real provider jobs and human review.

provider.note: The ledger records a conservative budget debit. Attach a complete Costs API export from a dedicated provider project for actual reported cost; invoice cost requires separate reconciliation.
